issue.statement: Certify the Effect 4 Surface publication delta against the immutable Effect 3 baseline.

aggregate.cause: Effect 4 publication encoding changed the key order of the anchored-trigger mechanics object for one record while retaining the same values.
aggregate.issue: The aggregate bytes changed, but recursively key-sorted content and the ordered record identity projection remain equal.

schema.cause: Effect 4 schema encoding regenerated the reviewed v4 local definition graph with renamed and deduplicated definitions. Its byte hashes authenticate that reviewed graph; they do not establish schema-language equivalence.
schema.issue: The schema bytes and local definition/reference graph changed; local reference closure and finite AJV cross-validation of the two canonical aggregate snapshots must remain as recorded.

verification.canonicalJson: JSON object keys are sorted recursively; array order is retained.
verification.orderedIdHash: SHA-256(JSON.stringify(ordered IDs)) for each aggregate family and their concatenation.
verification.schemaReferences: Every $ref is a local #/$defs reference whose definition exists.
verification.schemaCrossValidation: Finite AJV checks validate each canonical baseline and candidate aggregate snapshot against each reviewed schema snapshot; this does not prove schema-language equivalence.
